goal.text: The wearer is hunting for a missing item around the house and wants the assistant to retrace what she has already touched, where she has already been, and confirm the search ended with the item handed over.

turns.text: When I first leaned over, which hand reached?

trigger.detail: she straightens up out of the pointing gesture and opens a thread about what she did on the way in

expected_answer.text: Your left hand. You leaned left to touch it, stood up, then leaned left a second time to touch it again.

turns.text: And then — pointing at the picture frames, was that the same arm?

trigger.detail: the pointing gesture ends as she turns clockwise and walks forward

expected_answer.text: Yes, the same one. You pointed with it at the frames while you spoke, and you were still pointing as you turned clockwise.

turns.text: actually — hold that thought, I'm still wandering.

trigger.detail: she is pacing the activity area with a hand on her chin, nothing has completed

expected_answer.text: No problem. I'll keep track while you walk and we can pick it back up whenever you like.

turns.text: That loop — which room did I enter first?

trigger.detail: she comes back out into the activity area, the loop through the two rooms is finished

expected_answer.text: The utility room first. You cut through it, turned right into the restroom, looked around, then came back out through the same room.

turns.text: Was there a mirror in there, or am I thinking of somewhere else?

trigger.detail: the fixtures in that room left view for good a few seconds earlier

expected_answer.text: Yes, there was. A mirror and a sink were both in view when you stepped in, and again on your way out.

turns.text: um, hang on — I'm walking into the kitchen, give me a second.

trigger.detail: she crosses the dining area into the kitchen mid-answer

expected_answer.text: Take your time. I'll watch what you do in there and you can ask me after.

turns.text: That cupboard — what did I do to see inside?

trigger.detail: she closes it with both hands and turns away to chat

expected_answer.text: You lifted up onto your toes, raising both heels, to see further in. Then you came down, shut it with both hands, and turned away.

turns.text: I touched something on the counter — did I take it?

trigger.detail: the whole kitchen sequence has closed, so the earlier step is now reviewable

expected_answer.text: No. You only put your right hand on the box sitting there, then went straight to the cabinet without lifting it.

turns.text: Mm-hm, mm — sorry, so after all that I handed my peer something. Where did that come from?

trigger.detail: the handover to the peer completes as she turns left

expected_answer.text: Off a hook on the wall in the living area. You grabbed it with your right hand, carried it in both, and passed it over.

turns.text: I'm in the bedroom. Keep count of where I check.

trigger.detail: she finishes crossing the hallway and bends forward over the bed

expected_answer.text: Will do. I'll track each place you search in here so we can tell what you have already covered.

turns.text: wait — I've shaken these covers twice, haven't I? Or once?

trigger.detail: the second two-handed lift drops back onto the bed

expected_answer.text: Twice. The first lift was with your right hand only, the second with both, and you dropped it back down each time.

turns.text: And now, down on the floor — am I getting anywhere?

trigger.detail: she has gone down on one knee and is peering low, mid-answer

expected_answer.text: Nearly. You are down on one knee with the blanket held up, and your arm is reaching under the bed frame.

turns.text: hey, sorry — what have I actually got hold of down here?

trigger.detail: she reaches sideways and closes her hand on something out of sight

expected_answer.text: A stuffed toy. You reached sideways to the left for it and came up holding it in your left hand.

turns.text: Got it — so that's the thing I was after. Did it end up with my peer, like the other one did?

trigger.detail: she stands up out of the kneel holding the find

expected_answer.text: It did. You carried it through the hallway in both hands and handed it to your peer by the centre table.
